## <a href="https://www.carrerasresearch.org/en/regulatory-genomics" target="_blank">Vavouri's lab</a>, <a href="https://www.carrerasresearch.org/en" target="_blank"><i>Institut Josep Carreras</i></a>

<p style='font-size:15px;color:gray'><em style='color:black;'>August 2021 - Present</em><br>
Bioinformatician & master's thesis student</p>

---

Under the supervision of Dr. Tanya Vavouri, I am studying the PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs), and the evolution and conservation of piRNA-producing loci. During this time, I have completed a Master's thesis in which I studied the piRNA variation across closely related mouse species and, currently, I am finishing a PhD thesis involving the study of piRNA cluster expression, evolution and conservation across mouse strains and species.


<!-- In addition, we collaborated with external researchers in a study about conserved non-coding elements (CNEs). -->

---

<ins>Tasks:</ins>

* Analyse and integrate distinct types of omics data, including bulk sequencing and 10x Xenium spatial transcriptomics. 
* Development of a small RNA-seq pipeline to analyse piRNA production in several species.
* 10x Xenium spatial transcriptomics: design of probes for custom panel, analysis of single-cell RNA-seq data as reference, cellular and subcellular analysis of 10x Xenium data. 
* Retrieve and analyze multiple-sequence alignments using ENSEMBL Compara Perl API to obtain orthologous regions between mouse strains and species and get the blocks without gaps in the multiple-sequence alignment.
* Mentoring of bachelor's and master's thesis students.
* Developing outreach activities addressed to high-school and undergraduate students.
* Scientific writting

---
